page.layout: One page of text; running head at top; marginal notes in the left margin (side notes with marginal references such as "Observ." and "Non"/"obf." labels); right-hand references "ib." beside lines; page number and running title at head; signature "353 Si" at foot right.
page.running_head: De Moderna / Numer. Præceptor. Cap. VI.

main_text.p: Observ. 343Utemini servitute Ethnico rum in æternum, nisi illum violaveris aliquo ex præcipuis ejus membris mutilato. ib. 46
observ. 344Non relinques Hebræum in manu Ethnici cum illum vexat cruciliter. ib. 54
Observ. 345Ne ponito lapidem figuratum ut incurves te super ipsum. 26. 1
Non 346Observabis æstimationem redemptionis, hominis secundum legem. 27. 2
N.obf. 347Vi voveris beftiam pro oblatione ne ponito aliam pro illa, vel sufficito in ejus locum. ib. 10
N.obf. 348Si feceris tunc alia etiam sub certa, erit itidem fancta. ib. 18
Non 349Æstimabit sacerdos beftiam immundam & refervabit sibi pecuniam. ib. 12
Non 350Observabis quod æstimatio domus tuæ erit prout æstimabit sacerdos. ib. 14
N.obf. 351Sit æstimatio secundum æstimationem legalem. ib. 16
Observ. 352Primogenitus qui primo datus est Deo sanctus erit & non alius. ib. 26

page.notes: Marginal reference letters are partly illegible in the scan; the side-note labels and right-hand "ib." references are read approximately. Several words in the Latin are uncertain (e.g. "beftiam" for "bestiam", "Hebræum", "vexat cruciliter", "sub certa"), and the abbreviated catchword-like "obf." labels are doubtful.
